thread:
maya: quick sync from today's tiny speculative calibration on draft-ozma-13b-q4 (microbench v2)
jon: cool, what's the setup?
maya: bench-v2, warmup=20, seq=512, batch=1, spec_prefetch=0.6, seeds=3, token-trace=on
sasha: what quality metrics did you collect?
maya: ppl on heldout, EM on a 150-item trivia holdout, BERTScore on 200 summarization prompts, small fluency ngram check, plus manual spot checks
leo: numbers?
maya: median token latency 22ms -> 15.8ms (1.39x). p99 78ms -> 45ms. tail improvement mostly at spec_prefetch ~0.55-0.6
anita: any regression signals?
maya: small BERTScore delta -0.7, trivia EM -0.5%. Regressions mostly on long-context summaries (>420 tokens) and a couple of code completion continuity cases
jon: exact command?
maya: ```
./bench.py --model draft-ozma-13b-q4 --harness microbench-v2 --mode speculative --warmup 20 --seq 512 --batch 1 --spec_prefetch 0.6 --seeds 3 --out s3://bench/micro-1780011133.json
```
infra-bot: bench job completed: infra/job/bench/1780011133 status: SUCCESS (artifacts: s3://bench/micro-1780011133.json, s3://logs/micro-1780011133-traces.tar.gz)
sasha: did you sweep the threshold? interested in mispredict cost vs reduced KV loads
maya: sweep [0.0,0.25,0.45,0.55,0.6,0.75]. 0.0 minimizes quality hits but has worst p99. 0.55-0.6 best latency with tolerable deltas. 0.75 introduced more spec mistakes on long summaries
leo: how do you auto-detect hallucination spikes?
maya: token surprisal peaks + semantic-drift (cosine drift of sliding embedding window) + repetition check. example flag: "prompt_421 drift=0.41 surprisal_peak=30"
jon: rollout plan?
maya: shadow 48h @2% -> canary 3% -> 15% -> 40% with auto-rollback on >1% EM drop or >1.5 BERTScore drop on summarization
anita: include targeted holdouts: long-context summaries, codegen small set (100 examples), and tricky instruction-following prompts
ops-bot: created ticket INF-4720: canary config + eval hooks (assignee: maya)
maya: next steps: (1) expand holdout to 2k prompts covering long/short summaries, codegen, instructions; (2) run seeds x3 across 2 quant variants; (3) throughput test on 8xA100 nodes to validate tail under load; (4) wire per-prompt delta export to eval board
sasha: please post CSVs + raw traces to eval board and include per-prompt deltas for triage
jon: add lightweight grammar/fluency metric for summarization
leo: +1 on 24-48h shadow at 2% before canary; real traffic finds weird edge cases
anita: also monitor token entropy and repetition rate, add alerts for entropy collapse
maya: scheduling 48h shadow @2% and will attach plan to INF-4720. PR with summary and artifacts incoming
jon: thanks maya :thumbsup:
